fields.failure_code: stable bounded report-worker failure code <=64 ASCII token characters; never raw exception/message/path/body text

rules: the report worker/orchestrator durably assigns one UUID command_id to this exact failure transition before first invocation and reuses it on every retry
COMMAND_ENVELOPE_V1 request_hash binds report_attempt_id, expected_attempt_revision and exact failure_code

exact committed replay is resolved before current state/revision checks so a crash after the failed transition safely returns the original ReportAttemptV1 without a second cleanup, revision advance or audit
failure_code is a stable machine category owned by the report-worker/durable-job failure taxonomy and cannot persist arbitrary exception text, stack traces, filesystem details or source payloads
the request carries no filesystem cleanup target; any temporary candidate identity is derived only from persisted attempt/job state and the already-validated destination context
